# @zakkster/lite-scope

Scope Probe Protocol (SPP v1) core for the @zakkster profiler suite.
Zero-dependency single-file ESM (Scope.js). Zero-GC write path.

Record = 4 f64 slots [packed, t, a, b]; packed = (streamId<<16|opcode)>>>0,
both u16. t = ms since scope epoch. Wide payloads chain CONT records
(opcode 0x0F01, max 2 per base, static width per op). Opcode high byte is
the family block: 0x01 trace, 0x02 gc, 0x03 signal, 0x04 gpu+frame,
0x05 layout, 0x06 inp, 0x07 worker, 0x08 leak, 0x09 profiler phase telemetry,
0x0A profiler counter telemetry, 0x0F meta/gate.
Strings are interned to u32 ids at init (scope.intern); never on the wire.

API: createScope({sink,clock,epochWallMs}) -> { register(desc)->channel,
streams(), intern(), stringTable(), now(), setClockOffset(ms), widthOf(packed),
emitEpoch(), metaWrite(op,t,a,b) }. channel = { id, write(op,t,a,b),
cont(c0,c1,c2), intern }. Sinks: createMemorySink(capacityRecords) pow2
overwrite-oldest ring (write/forEach/toSlab/size/totalWritten/overflow/clear),
createMuxSink(sinks), createNullSink(). Decoder: readSlab(slab, widthOf, cb)
with cb(packed, t, payloadScratch, payloadCount).

Probes never import this package: they receive sink/channel by DI and speak
the protocol (single method sink.write(packed,t,a,b)). Normative spec in
PROTOCOL.md; golden vectors in vectors.json (vendored by probe repos).

v1.0.0 adds scope.gate.mjs: drop-in CI gate script template. Evaluates SPP
stream budgets, exit codes 0 pass / 1 regression. NDJSON output for CI
artifacts. VersionMatrix-compatible (exit 3 reserved for the matrix runner's
recapture semantics, never emitted by the gate itself). CI-RECIPE.md has
the GitHub Actions recipe and budget examples.

v1.1.0 assigns block 0x09 (lite-profiler phase telemetry): one "phase-telemetry"
stream, three width-1 LEVEL ops 0x0900 phase.avg / 0x0901 phase.p99 / 0x0902
phase.max, a = stat ms, b = interned phase-tag id. Additive in reserved space;
SPP stays v1. lite-scope owns the block; lite-profiler is the sole producer and
inlines the opcodes (imports nothing). See PROTOCOL.md block 0x09 + the
phaseTelemetry golden vector.

v1.2.0 assigns block 0x0A (lite-profiler counter telemetry): one "counter-telemetry"
stream, three width-1 LEVEL ops 0x0A00 counter.avg / 0x0A01 counter.max / 0x0A02
counter.last, a = stat count, b = interned counter-tag id. The trio is avg/max/last
(not phase's avg/p99/max): counters are deterministic lower-is-better integers, so
last (current-frame value) and max (gated ceiling) replace the percentile. Additive
in reserved space; SPP stays v1. lite-scope owns the block; lite-profiler is the sole
producer and inlines the opcodes (imports nothing). See PROTOCOL.md block 0x0A + the
counterTelemetry golden vector.
